name: Che dau xanh
summary: Mung-bean sweet soup, fragrant with coconut milk.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article lists it with chè bắp and chè hạt sen.
howToEat: Order a bowl after the meal.
seoTitle: Che dau xanh — mung-bean sweet soup in Hoi An
seoDescription: Chè đậu xanh in Hoi An is a mung-bean sweet soup fragrant with coconut milk.
